Authenticated A function in which plaintext is encrypted into ciphertext, and a encryption MAC is generated on the plaintext or ciphertext and, optionally, on associated data that is not encrypted. Cryptographic A well-defined computational procedure that takes variable inputs algorithm that may include a cryptographic key to provide confidentiality, data integrity, authentication and/or non-repudiation. Cryptographic key A binary string that is used as a parameter by a cryptographic (key) algorithm. Data protection key A key or a set of keys used to protect or recover data, verify the authenticity or integrity of the protected data or to protect the private key used to generate digital signatures. Decryption The process of transforming ciphertext into plaintext using a cryptographic algorithm and key. Digest size The output length of a hash function. Encryption The process of transforming plaintext into ciphertext using a cryptographic algorithm and key. Entropy A measure of the amount of uncertainty in an unknown value. Iteration count The number of times that the pseudorandom function is called to generate a block of keying material. Key See cryptographic key.

contents.html: Key derivation In this Recommendation, key derivation is the process of deriving keying material from a key or password. Keying material A binary string, such that any non-overlapping segments of the string with the required lengths can be used as symmetric cryptographic keys. Master key In this Recommendation, a master key is the keying material that is output from an execution of the PBKDF. Message (Data) A mechanism to provide assurance of the origin and integrity of a authentication message. Message A cryptographic checksum that is generated on data using a authentication code cryptographic algorithm that is parameterized by a symmetric key. The message authentication code is designed to provide data origin authentication and detect both accidental errors and the intentional modification of the data. Also called an authentication tag. Password A character string known only by a specific entity (e.g., a user) that is used to authenticate the identity of a computer system user and/or to authorize access to system resources. In this Recommendation, a password is used to derive keying material. Passphrase A collection of words (typically more than 20 characters), that is used to authenticate the identity of a computer system user and/or to authorize access to system resources. In this Recommendation, when “passphrase” is not mentioned with “password”, the use of “passphrase” is implied. Protect data To encrypt, authenticate, or both encrypt and authenticate data. Pseudorandom A function that can be used to generate output from a random seed Function and a data variable, such that the output is computationally indistinguishable from truly random output. Recover data To decrypt ciphertext data and/or to verify the authenticity of data. Salt A non-secret binary value that is used as an input to the key derivation function PBKDF specified in this Recommendation to allow the generation of a large set of keys for a given password. Shall This term is used to indicate a requirement that must be fulfilled to claim conformance to this Recommendation. Note that shall may be coupled with not to become shall not.
contents.html_ja: 鍵導出：本勧告では、鍵またはパスワードから鍵素材を導出する処理。鍵素材：必要な長さの連続しない部分列を対称鍵として使えるビット列。マスター鍵：本勧告では、PBKDFの実行結果として出力される鍵素材。メッセージ（データ）認証：メッセージの送信元および完全性を保証する仕組み。メッセージ認証コード（MAC）：対称鍵をパラメータとする暗号アルゴリズムを使い、データに対して生成される暗号学的チェックサム。データの送信元を認証し、偶発的な誤りと意図的な改変の両方を検出するよう設計される。認証タグとも呼ばれる。パスワード：特定の主体（例：利用者）のみが知る文字列であり、コンピュータシステム利用者の本人認証やシステム資源へのアクセス許可に使われる。本勧告では鍵素材の導出に用いる。パスフレーズ：通常20文字を超える単語の集まりで、コンピュータシステム利用者の本人認証やシステム資源へのアクセス許可に使われる。本勧告で「パスワード」と併記せずに「パスフレーズ」と記載した場合も、パスフレーズの使用を意味する。データ保護：データを暗号化する、認証する、または暗号化と認証の両方を行うこと。疑似ランダム関数：ランダムシードとデータ変数から出力を生成でき、その出力が真のランダム出力と計算上区別できない関数。データ復旧：暗号文データを復号する、またはデータの真正性を検証すること。ソルト：特定のパスワードから多数の鍵を生成できるよう、本勧告で規定するPBKDFへの入力として使う秘密ではないバイナリ値。「shall」：本勧告への適合を主張するために満たす必要がある要件を示す用語。「shall not」を表す場合は「shall」に「not」を組み合わせます。
